book.name: EFEDZE
book.title: Mukaana a Poole Kundaa basi Efedze

content: Otwu nyuru a Kriste mu bumõ ya mu dzyi
Mu obo, me ngwi be mpama, me wu ndi mu boloko mu kuulu me aakansalala Mfumu, mu okala a nzya-nzyara yi faana ya mbili yi líkihi be,
kunsa okughulu kwohono ya mu edzuunu, ya okakuru mukolo mu okebe. Mu dzyi, liikakuru mukolo mu nzya-nzyara a babake be a be,
bu lisi makpa mu okakebe bumõ bu ookagwa Mufulu mu munama wu edzuunu.
Oli a nyuru yini a mõ ya Mufulu yini a mumõ, bumõ si Nzaami áti be mbili mu emiini yini a emõ.

content.text: Oli a Mfumu yini a mumõ, kana yini a limõ, liboghoro yini a limõ,
Nzaami yini a mumõ ya Taara a bwohono,
wu aakatumu bwohono, wu aakasala mu bwohono, ya wu li mu bwohono.

content: Lo kundaa nswe mbwuru mu bihi, baagwi bwehe, ti bwunu a bu oli eteese ki ekaba e Kriste.
Me mu obo bályele ti:
Nde ákumu! Bunu odzyi olyele, nsomo nde akumu, nde átswama okumunu ku nsini a nsie?
Munde wu aakumunu, me wuunu munde si aakumu ku nkara a mayulu mwohono, mpaala aluhu bilogho byehene.
Ya nde aasi kuulu ti, bana bakala bantumu, babamõ mibighili, babake ba baakatsala nsia yi mbwe, ya babake minkaala bibuolo ya baluo.
Nde aasi obo mu kuulu baba ngili bakala ba bakughu mu osala esala kii otwu nyuru a Kriste,
tee mu matala ma liito bihi bwohono mu bumõ bu kana ya ligyahaba li Mwana a Nzaami, ya bihi sa likala kara a mukughu ti anga Kriste wu li mukughu.
Mu obo, bihi ka lifirikala bike-bike o, ba ookanyihi mampo ma madza ya ba ookabiri bifulu bibi maluo. Bihi ka lifirikihi o ti bakaŋene ya ba bakadzihibi bihi mu mpya ya mayele baara ma mabi.
Lo bu liikalyele ngaŋma munsa dzyi, bihi lifaana okulu mu mandagha mwohono mu Kriste, nde wu li mutswi.
Me mu nde, binama bi nyuru byehe bibvuŋunu ebini emõ mu libaha li misunu ya mikaã. Mu obo, ŋa okasala nswe enama bwunu a bu ofaana, nyuru yohono yiikakulu mu dzyi.
Mbwuru wu mukulu ya mbwuru wu munyaghara
Mu obo, ndagha yi ndyele me ya yinsuo me be bumpughulu mu Mfumu me yi: Ka lifirikala a nzya-nzyara a baara ba bagwene osoolo Nzaami o, baala bitsimi bi bo yini a mu mandagha ma magwene a mupfunu.
Mayele ma bo mali kunsa mpyibi, ya bo bali banzyi mu bumweẽ bu Nzaami, mu nkooro a nzi-nzimini yi li mu bo ya mu nkooro a mikolo ngyi mi bo.
Bo ka baafirikamono bupfiri o, bo áyi batyeghe manyuru ma bo mu mandagha mama enkwunu, bo baakagyighili mandagha mama osuŋumu mama mawa-mawa.
Lo be, ka obo be liisoolo Kriste o,
kala ti me nde be liigyughu ya baaluo be, ti bwunu a bu oli engaŋma ki eli mu Yiisu.
Lo be lifaana odzwulu embwuru e be ki ekulu ki efaana ya nzya-nzyara a be yi nkulu, ya ki eekabyihi kyeme mu manzala ma kye mama mpya.
Be lifaana okighiri mu mufulu mu mayele ma be
ya olaha embwuru ki enyaghara, ki baagyighili mu efa kii Nzaami, munsa bunsumu ya bungili bu buukaburu engaŋma.
Mu obo, linyaã mpya ya nswe mbwuru mu be akalyele engaŋma kundaa nganda a nde, mu kuulu bihi-a-be lili binama bibi nyuru mõ.
Mu matala ma liikabagha be nkehe, ka likasa masumu o. Tala linyaã odzyama ŋaala be lili nkini ya nkehe.
Ka likagwa mpeene kundaa dyabulu o.
Muturu anyaã ofirikaturu. Lo nde akasa mpini mu osala mu myaã mi nde esala ki ebwe, mpaala nde abagha ki aagwa kundaa wu aakeghele.
Ndagha si mõ yi mbi yinyaã opala mu miŋma mi be. Lo kala ti yo yipala, lo yikala yimbwe, yi aatwu, ya yi aagwa bwehe kundaa ba baagyughu yo.
Ka likagwa Mufulu a Ngili a Nzaami nyiĩ o, mu kuulu mu nde bási be elyimi mu etsughu ki akala ookwulu be Nzaami.
Limaha ŋa kara be nkala, kakaba, nkehe, kyele, bitughu, ya mandagha mwohono ma mabi.
Liikakala baara ba babwe ya banga a mikolo nyiĩ be a be, liikasa be a be kolokolo, ti bwunu a bu ósi be Nzaami kolokolo mu Kriste.
